claims.text: No. The brochure lists 4% p.a. as the current assumed base crediting interest rate, quoted as of January 2022, and expressly states that it is not guaranteed and may change. It separately describes a guaranteed floor after the policy has been in force for at least 15 years: the Account Value is guaranteed to have accumulated to at least the amount that would result from a 2.5% p.a. credited interest rate, regardless of economic conditions. The 0.25% retrospective additional interest rate is also an assumed, non-guaranteed rate.

For the automatic periodic withdrawal option, the policy must have been in force for at least 10 years for the withdrawal charge to be waived. The brochure lists a minimum monthly withdrawal of US$500/HK$4,000/MOP4,000, with a minimum withdrawal period of one year; alternatively, a minimum annual withdrawal of US$6,000/HK$48,000/MOP48,000, with a minimum withdrawal period of three years. Changes after the application is confirmed incur a nominal fee. The option is available when sufficient Cash Value has accumulated, and withdrawals reduce Cash Value while monthly charges continue to be deducted; if the Cash Value cannot cover those charges, the policy will lapse with zero value.

claims.text: If the Policy Owner is made redundant, the brochure lists an option to suspend premium payments for 365 days—the “Special Grace Period.” It also states that you remain fully covered by the insurance throughout that period. This unemployment protection is applicable only to the Basic Plan, so the brochure does not include riders in this specific redundancy-related premium-suspension benefit.

This Basic Plan restriction does not establish that all rider coverage stops or that rider premiums are waived. The brochure describes supplementary benefits as available for an additional premium, but it does not specify how riders are treated during the 365-day Special Grace Period.

claims.text: 这份宣传册无法确定豁免保费保障是否包括受保人65岁生日当天。中文写作“65岁或以前”，按字面可涵盖65岁当天；英文则写作“before the age of 65”，按字面表示须在满65岁之前。两种表述在65岁生日的边界上不一致，因此应以正式保单条款核实，不能仅凭本册统一解释。
